pages.text: “A balance between strength and gentleness, semi-fermented with complex layers, carrying a hidden power of protection.”$(br2)Oolong Tea is a partially fermented tea that lies between black tea and green tea, made from two portions of dried oolong tea leaves. The golden-hued tea is rich in flavor. Drinking it provides a Resistance boost, allowing travelers to withstand more damage.
$(br2)$(br)To prepare Oolong Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried oolong tea leaves.$(br)It is best consumed during battles or in hazardous environments to enhance survivability.

Upon drinking Oolong Tea, travelers gain a Resistance boost, reducing incoming damage.$(br)This tea is perfect for combat preparation and tough encounters.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
